neutral.EN: What the hell?! Stay back!
Why are you attacking me?! Get back!
neutral.TL: Bakit mo ako inaatake?! Lumayo ka!

neutral.EN: Stop! What are you doing?!
Don't touch me! Are you crazy?!
neutral.TL: Huwag mo akong hawakan! Nababaliw ka na ba?!

neutral.EN: Get away from me right now!
neutral.TL: Umalis ka sa harap ko ngayon din!

neutral.EN: Jesus, back off! Put that away!
Why would you hit me?! Get back!
neutral.TL: Bakit mo ako sinaktan?! Lumayo ka!

neutral.EN: Stay away from me! Don't do this!
neutral.TL: Lumayo ka sa akin! Huwag mong gawin 'to!

neutral.EN: Are you out of your mind?! Stop!

neutral.EN: Back off! Don't come any closer!
You just made a big mistake.
All right. You want a fight, you've got one.
neutral.TL: Sige. Gusto mo ng laban, makukuha mo.

neutral.EN: You hit me? You're going to regret that.
Try that again and see what happens.
neutral.TL: Ulitin mo pa at tignan natin ang mangyayari.

neutral.EN: Wrong person to mess with.
You want some of this?! Come on then!
neutral.TL: Gusto mo pala ng gulo?! Halika rito!

neutral.EN: That was your last free shot.
I'll put you in the ground for that.
You swung at me? Big mistake.
You really want to do this? Let's go.
That's it. You're done.
Bad choice. Defend yourself.
neutral.TL: Maling desisyon. Ipagtanggol mo ang sarili mo.

neutral.TL: Binigyan kita ng puwang. Ipagtanggol mo sarili mo ngayon.

neutral.EN: That's where this ends.
You made your choice.
neutral.TL: Pumili ka na ng kahihinatnan mo.

neutral.EN: I won't let you hurt me. Stand down or fight.

neutral.EN: Unacceptable. Drop your weapon.
neutral.TL: Hindi katanggap-tanggap. Ibaba mo ang sandata mo.

neutral.EN: You crossed the line.
Stand down right now, or I finish this.
neutral.TL: Tumigil ka ngayon din, o tatapusin ko 'to.

neutral.EN: Back off. Now.
Enough. Stay away from me.
neutral.TL: Tama na. Lumayo ka sa akin.

neutral.EN: Step back.
Do not do that again.
Don't touch me.
Last warning.
Stay back.
Drop it.
Keep your distance.
One step back. Right now.
Why did you do that?!
What the hell is wrong with you?!
Hey! Watch what you're doing!
neutral.TL: Hoy! Tingnan mo ang ginagawa mo!

neutral.EN: Did you just swing at me?!
Are you trying to kill me?!
What are you thinking?! Stop it!
Whoa! Back off!
Don't hit me! What's wrong with you?!
neutral.TL: Huwag mo akong saktan! Ano bang nangyayari sa'yo?!

neutral.EN: Stop swinging at me!
Back away from me!
